d: In this video, we are taking a detailed look at the all-new OPPO Enco X4. This TWS earbuds come with an 11mm woofer, a 6mm planar tweeter, dual DACs, Dynaudio tuning, and LHDC lossless audio support. You also get a 10-band Sound Master EQ, Spatial Audio with head tracking, and multiple EQ profiles for different listening preferences. For noise cancellation, the Enco X4 features 3 microphones in each earbud, a 6nm NPU, Adaptive ANC, Transparency Mode, and Conversation Awareness.
